title: Rampo
overview:
This world is a dream. Only the dreams of night are true.

Early Showa era - popular mystery writer Edogawa Rampo encountered a case that would change his life as a writer...

You play Rampo himself. Struggling to write while his editor Seishi Yokomizo presses him for a manuscript, Rampo goes to collect rent at the men-only boarding house he manages and finds that someone has been secretly bringing a woman inside - the first thread of a much larger mystery.

This first-person adventure combines live-action actors with pre-rendered sets. Move from spot to spot, examine objects closely, pick up items and use them from your inventory in the right places or during conversations. Based on the film Rampo.

- 1 player
- Two discs
- Memory backup support

現し世は夢
夜の夢こそまこと。

昭和初期――人気推理作家・江戸川乱歩はその作家人生を変えるような事件に遭遇した……。
